bestBets.overview: Track rated soft 7 at the time of acceptances with mostly sunny but cold weather forecast leading up to the meeting. MALAY PENINSULA finished a close third in a 900m Muswellbrook trial on July 15th. He has drawn to get a good run from barrier 4 and will carry 55kg after Izzy Neale's claim. MONGOLIAN MASTER (ex Danny O'Brien) is a newcomer to NSW and hasn't been seen in any recent trials. He was runner-up at Tatura on debut last year. MINERS MATE was slow to begin and never in contention at Bathurst last time. Forgive that effort and go on his good run at Quirindi the start prior.

bestBets.overview: KAWATIRI had to work hard on the speed at Quirindi last time and only beat one home but she wasn't far from the winner. Has drawn favourably in gate 3 and will carry 56kg after Izzy Neale's claim. MISS MERCY was able to lead throughout when she won at Tamworth last start. She has been kept fresh for this. RAY DEL NORTE has been freshened and is back in distance since running third at Quirindi last month. There were some excuses for OCTAVIAN TREASURE at Port Macquarie last time. Perhaps she can improve. SOOBOOCO, NOR NOR WEST and CRAIG'S ONE are other with claims.
